stories.title: France sees third weekend of protests as police fire tear gas
stories.summary: Hundreds of thousands marched across France on Saturday over living costs and education, and police fired tear gas as clashes broke out after dark in Paris, Lyon and Toulouse. Interior ministry tallied 320,000 protesters nationwide, down from prior weeks.

stories.title: Oleshky evacuees reunite with families in Ukraine after ceasefire
stories.summary: Hundreds evacuated from the Russian-occupied frontline city of Oleshky under a Melania Trump-brokered ceasefire crossed into Ukraine, reuniting with relatives they had not seen for years.

stories.title: DR Congo Ebola deaths top 5,000 in deadliest outbreak
stories.summary: Deaths in the Democratic Republic of Congo's deadliest Ebola outbreak passed 5,000, with cases now recorded in neighboring countries and no approved treatment or vaccine available.

stories.title: Poland's top court standoff escalates as chief judge ousted
stories.summary: A bid to remove nationalist-linked leadership from Poland's Constitutional Tribunal saw the chief judge ousted, sparking accusations of a coup and clashes between protesters and riot police in Warsaw.

stories.title: Google AI gets cagey when asked who won the 2020 election
stories.summary: Google's AI Mode declines to name the 2020 presidential winner, pointing users to official records instead; Google blames a technical gap in election verification it says it is fixing.

stories.title: Google DeepMind releases Gemini 4 Carbon frontier model
stories.summary: Two weeks after Argon, Google DeepMind shipped Gemini 4 Carbon, which tops the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index and is built for multi-day autonomous coding and cyber-defense workflows.

stories.title: Google joins rivals in promising new AI scraping controls
stories.summary: Google, OpenAI, Anthropic and Microsoft committed to honoring a new robots.txt directive that lets publishers opt out of AI-training scraping of their content.

stories.title: OpenAI and ServiceNow integrate agentic workflows
stories.summary: OpenAI models and agents now integrate directly into ServiceNow workflows, while ServiceNow's enterprise capabilities come to ChatGPT and Codex to streamline corporate automation.

stories.title: Tytus Howard cleared to start at right tackle vs Steelers
stories.summary: Right tackle Tytus Howard cleared concussion protocol and will start Sunday as the 5-2 Browns visit Pittsburgh with first place in the AFC North on the line.

stories.title: Mike Hall Jr. available for Steelers game after ankle injury
stories.summary: Defensive tackle Mike Hall Jr. is off the injury report and will play Sunday, his first game since suffering a high-ankle sprain against Pittsburgh on Oct. 1.

stories.title: Browns elevate rookie TE Carsen Ryan for Steelers game
stories.summary: Cleveland elevated rookie tight end Carsen Ryan from the practice squad for Sunday's game, days after waiving and re-signing the seventh-round pick.

stories.title: Browns work out five players ahead of Steelers matchup
stories.summary: The Browns worked out five players, including former Colorado receiver Xavier Weaver, as they look at practice-squad depth before Sunday's game in Pittsburgh.

stories.title: Ohio State-USC odds and picks for Halloween night clash
stories.summary: Ohio State visits USC (7:30 p.m. ET, NBC) as a 6.5-point favorite with Luke Fahey set for his first career start; CBS Sports leans on the Under 51.5 with a first-time QB on the road.

stories.title: Herbstreit's advice for Luke Fahey's first Ohio State start
stories.summary: Kirk Herbstreit says Luke Fahey must lean on the talent around him and 'just don't lose the game' as the freshman makes his first start at USC in place of injured Julian Sayin.

stories.title: Buckeyes need complete game to support new QB vs USC
stories.summary: No. 2 Ohio State (6-1) plays its first game without QB Julian Sayin, leaning on a full-team effort to beat a USC team fighting to keep its playoff hopes alive.

stories.title: What's next for Ohio State after Julian Sayin's injury
stories.summary: Ohio State heads to USC without starting QB Julian Sayin, who has an arm injury, with true freshman Luke Fahey expected to take over under center.

stories.title: Norris tops final Mexico City practice by 0.001s
stories.summary: Lando Norris edged title leader Kimi Antonelli by one millisecond to top FP3 at the Mexico City Grand Prix, with Charles Leclerc third and Oscar Piastri fourth.

stories.title: Antonelli closes in on maiden title ahead of Mexico qualifying
stories.summary: Mercedes' Kimi Antonelli, on the verge of clinching his first F1 championship this weekend, finished a millisecond behind Lando Norris in final practice; qualifying follows later Saturday.

stories.title: Dublin-based Wendy's receives $1.4B purchase offer from Nelson Peltz
stories.summary: Nelson Peltz has made a $1.4 billion purchase offer for Dublin, Ohio-based Wendy's, according to NBC4.

stories.title: Neighbors demand safety changes after crash injures five children
stories.summary: Residents are calling for change after a Morse Road crash sent five children and two adults to the hospital in critical condition on the city's North Side.

stories.title: Reynoldsburg man charged with felony rape after child's report
stories.summary: A Reynoldsburg man faces felony rape charges after a 12-year-old Lakewood Middle School student reported abuse to a school counselor.

stories.title: Shooting in south Franklinton sends one to hospital
stories.summary: One person is recovering after being shot early Saturday near Canonby Place in south Franklinton; police found the victim around 12:30 a.m. and reported no suspects yet.
